items.headline: Heat Bolster Roster with Johnson, Richards Signings
items.summary: The Miami Heat continue to build around Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo, signing Keshad Johnson to a two-way contract and Nick Richards to a one-year deal. Johnson, who previously spent two seasons with the Heat, appeared in 32 games in 2025-26, averaging 4.3 points. Richards, a 28-year-old center, averaged 5.8 points and 5.1 rebounds across 48 games with the Suns and Bulls last season.

items.headline: Timberwolves Eyeing Trade Candidates After Kuminga Deal
items.summary: Following the acquisition of Jonathan Kuminga, two Minnesota Timberwolves players have emerged as potential trade candidates as the team looks to create additional cap flexibility. Kuminga himself agreed to a two-year, $13 million contract with Minnesota.

items.headline: 76ers Land Brown, LeBron to Form Powerhouse Lineup
items.summary: The Philadelphia 76ers have orchestrated a dramatic offseason, acquiring Jaylen Brown from the Boston Celtics in a blockbuster trade and signing LeBron James to a two-year deal after his departure from the Lakers. The moves create a formidable starting five featuring Brown, James, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, and VJ Edgecombe.

items.headline: Celtics Trade Brown for George, Boost Frontcourt
items.summary: The Boston Celtics traded Jaylen Brown to the 76ers for Paul George, two first-round picks, and two second-round picks. Boston also strengthened its frontcourt by signing Neemias Queta to a four-year, $56.0 million contract and Mitchell Robinson to a three-year, $47.4 million deal, and added Mike Conley.

items.headline: OKC Inks Isaiah Hartenstein to Three-Year Deal
items.summary: The Oklahoma City Thunder have secured center Isaiah Hartenstein on a three-year contract worth $75 million. This move is part of the Thunder's ongoing offseason roster adjustments.

items.headline: Nuggets Stretch Valanciunas Contract, Reduce Cap Hit
items.summary: The Denver Nuggets are stretching the remaining $2 million owed to Jonas Valanciunas for the 2026-27 season. This financial maneuver will result in a cap hit of approximately $667,000 for Denver over the next three seasons. Valanciunas was waived by the Nuggets in July and has since signed with Zalgiris in Europe.

items.headline: Raptors to Retire Kyle Lowry's No. 7 Jersey
items.summary: The Toronto Raptors will honor franchise legend Kyle Lowry by officially retiring his No. 7 jersey at Scotiabank Arena, a fitting tribute to the point guard who helped lead them to an NBA championship.

items.headline: Wembanyama Shines for France in World Cup Qualifiers
items.summary: Victor Wembanyama showcased his dominance on the international stage, leading France to a convincing 92-67 victory over Slovenia in a 2027 World Cup qualifier. The Spurs phenom recorded 22 points and 9 rebounds in just 21 minutes of play.

items.headline: All-Star Deni Avdija's Role in Portland Under Scrutiny
items.summary: 2026 NBA All-Star Deni Avdija remains a foundational piece for the Portland Trail Blazers, even as discussions arise regarding his offensive responsibilities following the acquisition of Ja Morant. Avdija had a breakout 2025-26 season, including two 40-point games, and led the Blazers back to the playoffs.

items.headline: NBA Summer League Memorabilia Auction Underway
items.summary: StockX and the NBA have launched an auction featuring game-worn memorabilia from the 2026 Summer League. The auction, which began today, August 28, and runs through September 1, includes items from standout young players like Cameron Boozer, Darryn Peterson, and Summer League MVP Yaxel Lendeborg.
